{{Top|leg}}
A '''sail ship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipped with sails that operated in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Their crew included light [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]] with [[agrinium]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating that maintained the sails.
